out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Ceasing Operations & Reporting (Voluntary for Imminent Health Hazard)
violations.observation: The permit holder failed to discontinue operations and notify the Health Department that an imminent health hazard may exist because of an emergency. Observed imminent health hazard (sewage back up) during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Facility voluntarily closed during inspection. EHS will conduct a follow up inspection once imminent health hazard is addressed. Please note, a re- inspection is REQUIRED prior to facility re-opening.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw shell egg above produce in 2 door upright.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC placed raw shell eggs below produce.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed cleaning spray stored next to single use items.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PIC relocated cleaning chemicals below single use items.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: sauces, spices at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Please label ALL food items once removed from working container. Ensure compliance by next routine inspection. Blue Deli & Cafe (Inspection Date: 04/10/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Observed mouse droppings along non food contact surface of window sill at dry storage and on floor in unisex bathroom
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. Please contact a certified pest control technician and submit invoice to EHS within 10 days.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Prohibited in Toilet Rooms
violations.observation: Food storage in toilet rooms. Observed drinks, chips, and food equipment stored in employee only restroom.
violations.corrective_action: Food may not be stored in toilet rooms. Please relocate all food and food equipment to kitchen. EHS will conduct a follow up within 10 days.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping cloths stored directly on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wet wiping cloths in sanitizer bucket with solution.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the 3 compartment sink are in poor repair. Observed water coming up from the floor pipe and leaking onto the floor when 3 compartment sink is run.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC contacted plumber. Please contact EHS once repair is made.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The sink basin for the hand sink at the cookline is slow to drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Please contact a plumber for repair. Ensure drain is in good repair by next routine inspection.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw shell egg stored above ready to eat tortillas and raw ground beef stored above tomato in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS conducted education regarding proper storage of raw animal foods. During inspection, PIC relocated tomato to other shelf. PIC relocated raw beef to bottom shelf of unit with raw shell eggs stored above raw ground beef on shelf.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed ranch dressing (52F) near stove.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS conducted education regarding proper cold holding temperatures. PIC relocated ranch to cold unit to be cooled to 41F or below within a remainder of 3.5 hours.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Materials Necessary to Operation
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed spray paint stored directly on sealed beverages in dry storage.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. PIC relocated spray paint away from dry storage.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed imitation crab with Alaskan polluck thawing in reduced oxygen packaging.
violations.corrective_action: EHS conducted education regarding proper thawing methods in ROP. PIC cut packaging open during inspection.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: observed imitation crab thawing at ambient room temperature.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS conducted education regarding proper thawing methods. PIC relocated imitation crab to refrigeration.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter with no sanitizer.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wet wiping cloths in sanitizer solution during inspection.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed knives stored in between prep units and counter, observed rice scoops stored in ambient water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed knives between prep unit/counter and removed rice scoops from water. Blue Deli & Cafe (Inspection Date: 10/21/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed that the end caps are missing from the protective light covering of fluorescent light fixtures in the back of kitchen and at front point of sale/prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide end caps to completely enclose the light bulb. PIC provided shielding during inspection.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. FOLLOW-UP inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No food manager observed present at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program.

violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC removed pitcher from hand sink.

violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC provided paper towel at bathroom hand washing sink.

PIC washed, rinsed, and sanitized internal surfaces of ice bin.
